title: Spreading a monoid section of a characteristic stalk quotient
statement: Let X be an fs locally Noetherian Zariski log scheme, c its fan chart to F, x a point, and L a normalized localization at c(x) [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup] [lem-trf-fine-fan-point-localization]. Put R=N_Z,x and P=P_F,c(x), with canonical quotient q:R → P [lem-trf-fan-chart-stalk-model]. Every monoid section j:P → R of q spreads to a monoid homomorphism h:P → N_Z(U) on an open neighborhood U of x contained in c^{-1}(L). The morphism c|U factors as a through L; on every restricted stalk the sharpening of h(p) equals the germ of the canonical section pulled back along a, and the ordinary germ of h(p) at x equals j(p) for every p. This asserts no log-chart property and involves no group-section choice.

source.place: ILO VI 3.7(a), p.75; VIII proof of 3.3.15, p.109.

proof.text: Pull back the canonical sections on the open of generalizations. Its normalized germ identifies them with the actual fan stalk. Represent the images of finitely many generators under j on a common neighborhood inside the inverse image of that open.

Use the finite relation presentation. Each defining relation is true at the marked stalk, so shrink for it. The finite intersection yields a section homomorphism with the prescribed germ. Empty generating or relation tuples cause no exception.

The sharp image of each lifted generator and the pulled-back canonical section have equal germs by the quotient-section hypothesis. Shrink for those finitely many equalities. Generation gives equality for every element. Restrict c to this neighborhood and the target open to obtain a and its factorization; naturality gives the displayed germ equalities at all points.

proof_origin.place: ILO VI 3.7(a), p.75; VIII proof of 3.3.15, p.109. Explicit subargument of lem-trf-fan-chart-local-monoid-lift.

mathlib_searches.query: A finitely generated commutative monoid homomorphism into a sheaf stalk extends to sections on a neighborhood using finite presentation
mathlib_searches.results: Returned ring structure-sheaf germs, finite-presentation locality of ring homomorphisms, and generating sections of modules. None supplies a monoid lift with prescribed characteristic sections.
Twelve elliptic curve normal form results, no logarithmic chart theorem.
Ordinary sheaf stalks and germs, local surjectivity, and sheafification. No logarithmic characteristic comparison, finite monoid lift, or chart criterion.

from.place: Historical nearby-duality/alteration branch of lem-trf-local-term-locality, proof (1)--(2), through lem-trf-log-regular-desingularization: monoidal resolution used for the regular modification of nodal pairs; ILO VIII 3.3.15, pp.109--110. Expose VIII, 3.3.2--3.3.13, pp.106--109, especially 3.3.4(ii), 3.3.8--3.3.11, 3.3.13(i),(iii); finite cover as in proof of 3.3.15. Subargument: returned log-fan-chart-blowup proof step(s) 3,4,5; Expose VIII 3.1.4(iii), 3.1.8(ii), 3.1.10(ii), pp.98--100; 3.3.12--3.3.13, pp.108--109: Zariski local lift expanded using free characteristic groups (VI 1.6, p.70). Subargument: Spreading a monoid section of a characteristic stalk quotient.

lean.statement:
theorem fan_chart_germ_spreading
    {X : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}} {F : FineFan.Fan.{u}}
    (c : LogFanChart X F) (x : X.scheme)
    (L : FineFan.PointLocalization F (c.map.hom.base x))
    (j : FineFan.stalk F.space.presheaf (c.map.hom.base x) →*
      FineFan.stalk X.logStructure.zariskiPresheaf x)
    (hj : ∀ p, c.stalkQuotient x (j p) = p) :
        ∃ (U : X.scheme.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U)
          (h : FineFan.stalk F.space.presheaf (c.map.hom.base x) →*
            X.logStructure.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op ((logOpenEtale X.scheme).obj U)))
          (a : X.logStructure.sharpSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding ⟶
            F.space.restrict L.openSet.isOpenEmbedding),
          (∀ y ∈ U, c.map.hom.base y ∈ L.openSet) ∧
          a ≫ F.space.ofRestrict L.openSet.isOpenEmbedding =
            X.logStructure.sharpSpace.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding ≫ c.map ∧
          (∀ (p : FineFan.stalk F.space.presheaf (c.map.hom.base x))
            (y : X.scheme) (hy : y ∈ U),
            FineFan.stalkMap (X.logStructure.sharpSpace.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding)
                ⟨y, hy⟩ (FineFan.germ X.logStructure.sharpSpace.presheaf U y hy
                  (X.logStructure.sharpSection U (h p))) =
              FineFan.germ (X.logStructure.sharpSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf
                ⊤ ⟨y, hy⟩ (by trivial) (FineFan.affinePullback (a ≫ L.iso.hom) p)) ∧
          ∀ p : FineFan.stalk F.space.presheaf (c.map.hom.base x),
            FineFan.germ X.logStructure.zariskiPresheaf U x hx (h p) = j p
